From eb2d16a7d599dc9d4df391b5e660df9949963786 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 17:02:10 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] af_key: validate families in pfkey_send_migrate()

syzbot was able to trigger a crash in skb_put() [1]

Issue is that pfkey_send_migrate() does not check old/new families,
and that set_ipsecrequest() @family argument was truncated,
thus possibly overfilling the skb.

Validate families early, do not wait set_ipsecrequest().

[1]

skbuff: skb_over_panic: text:ffffffff8a752120 len:392 put:16 head:ffff88802a4ad040 data:ffff88802a4ad040 tail:0x188 end:0x180 dev:<NULL>
 kernel BUG at net/core/skbuff.c:214 !
Call Trace:
 <TASK>
  skb_over_panic net/core/skbuff.c:219 [inline]
  skb_put+0x159/0x210 net/core/skbuff.c:2655
  skb_put_zero include/linux/skbuff.h:2788 [inline]
  set_ipsecrequest net/key/af_key.c:3532 [inline]
  pfkey_send_migrate+0x1270/0x2e50 net/key/af_key.c:3636
  km_migrate+0x155/0x260 net/xfrm/xfrm_state.c:2848
  xfrm_migrate+0x2140/0x2450 net/xfrm/xfrm_policy.c:4705
  xfrm_do_migrate+0x8ff/0xaa0 net/xfrm/xfrm_user.c:3150

Fixes: 08de61beab8a ("[PFKEYV2]: Extension for dynamic update of endpoint address(es)")
Reported-by: syzbot+b518dfc8e021988fbd55@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/netdev/69b5933c.050a0220.248e02.00f2.GAE@google.com/T/#u
Signed-off-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Cc: Steffen Klassert <steffen.klassert@secunet.com>
Cc: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>
Signed-off-by: Steffen Klassert <steffen.klassert@secunet.com>

diff --git a/net/key/af_key.c b/net/key/af_key.c
index 571200433aa9..bc91aeeb74bb 100644
--- a/net/key/af_key.c
+++ b/net/key/af_key.c
@@ -3518,7 +3518,7 @@ static int set_sadb_kmaddress(struct sk_buff *skb, const struct xfrm_kmaddress *
 
 static int set_ipsecrequest(struct sk_buff *skb,
 			    uint8_t proto, uint8_t mode, int level,
-			    uint32_t reqid, uint8_t family,
+			    uint32_t reqid, sa_family_t family,
 			    const xfrm_address_t *src, const xfrm_address_t *dst)
 {
 	struct sadb_x_ipsecrequest *rq;
@@ -3583,12 +3583,17 @@ static int pfkey_send_migrate(const struct xfrm_selector *sel, u8 dir, u8 type,
 
 	/* ipsecrequests */
 	for (i = 0, mp = m; i < num_bundles; i++, mp++) {
-		/* old locator pair */
-		size_pol += sizeof(struct sadb_x_ipsecrequest) +
-			    pfkey_sockaddr_pair_size(mp->old_family);
-		/* new locator pair */
-		size_pol += sizeof(struct sadb_x_ipsecrequest) +
-			    pfkey_sockaddr_pair_size(mp->new_family);
+		int pair_size;
+
+		pair_size = pfkey_sockaddr_pair_size(mp->old_family);
+		if (!pair_size)
+			return -EINVAL;
+		size_pol += sizeof(struct sadb_x_ipsecrequest) + pair_size;
+
+		pair_size = pfkey_sockaddr_pair_size(mp->new_family);
+		if (!pair_size)
+			return -EINVAL;
+		size_pol += sizeof(struct sadb_x_ipsecrequest) + pair_size;
 	}
 
 	size += sizeof(struct sadb_msg) + size_pol;
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

The patch fixes a bug in the `af_key` module where `pfkey_send_migrate()` could trigger a `skb_over_panic` due to insufficient validation of address families. The changes are confined to a single file: `net/key/af_key.c`.

### Modifications in `net/key/af_key.c`

1. **Type change in `set_ipsecrequest()` signature**  
   - Changed the `family` parameter type from `uint8_t` to `sa_family_t`.  
   - This prevents truncation of the family value (e.g., `AF_INET6` = 10), which previously could be silently clipped and lead to oversized `sockaddr` structure calculation.

2. **Validation of families in `pfkey_send_migrate()`**  
   - Added early validation of `mp->old_family` and `mp->new_family` for each migration bundle.  
   - For each family, `pfkey_sockaddr_pair_size()` is called; if it returns 0 (indicating an unsupported or invalid family), the function immediately returns `-EINVAL`.  
   - This ensures that only valid families are used for size computation and later for building the `sadb_x_ipsecrequest` entries.

### Relationship Between the Changes

The two modifications are logically connected:  
- The type fix ensures that `set_ipsecrequest()` correctly interprets the family value, avoiding memory overruns when the family was truncated.  
- The validation in `pfkey_send_migrate()` acts as a gatekeeper, preventing invalid families from ever reaching `set_ipsecrequest()` and causing a buffer overflow (as seen in the reported crash). Together, they enforce both correct data types and early input validation, eliminating the root cause of the bug.
